concerns.text: Task T017d implements 'local_prime_gap_variance' feature and 'Prime Gap Analysis' to address a 'von Neumann review' concern. However, spec.md FR-004 only mandates π(n), 1/ln(n), and distance to nearest prime. No FR or SC in spec.md authorizes gap-variance features. This task covers a non-existent requirement, leaving the spec's FR-004 unverified by a specific task for the mandated features if T017d is the only gap-related task.

Task T026a creates a 'Gap-Residual Correlation Plot' for 'local prime gap variance'. Spec.md FR-007 requires a plot of n vs R(n) and fitted correction, and FR-005 mentions oscillatory terms, but no FR/SC mandates a specific visualization for prime gap variance. This task covers a non-existent requirement.

Task T013a requires adding docstrings/logs 'as per the von Neumann review' regarding asymptotic regime justification. Spec.md contains no FR or SC requiring code documentation of the asymptotic regime or justification of n_max in logs. This task covers a non-existent requirement.

Task T030a updates research notes to distinguish unrestricted vs distinct-prime baselines 'addressing the von Neumann review'. Spec.md has no FR/SC requiring this specific documentation update in research_notes.md. This task covers a non-existent requirement.

Task T005 implements Q_as(n) based on 'distinct-partition variant of Meinardus' theorem (verified Roth & Szekeres 1954)'. Spec.md FR-002 mandates 'distinct-partition variant of Meinardus' theorem' but does not explicitly name Roth & Szekeres. While likely equivalent, the task's specific citation constraint is not explicitly mapped to an FR/SC, creating a potential traceability gap if the citation is considered a new requirement not in the spec.

Task T017d introduces 'local_prime_gap_variance' as a feature. Spec.md FR-004 lists specific features (π(n), 1/ln(n), distance to nearest prime) but does not include gap variance. There is no task explicitly implementing the 'distance to nearest prime' feature as a standalone item if T017d is the only task mentioning 'distance' (which it conflates with gap variance). This risks missing coverage for the explicit FR-004 requirement.
